AUTOSHUTDOWN.TITLE: Auto-Shutdown
AUTOSHUTDOWN.ENABLED_DOC: Enable or disable automatic power-off of the device when it remains inactive.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.INACTIVE_TIME_DOC: Duration in minutes without active playback or audio signal (PCM) before the system shuts down.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.CHECK_INTERVAL_DOC: Frequency at which the plugin queries Volumio playback status and audio hardware status (Default: 30 seconds).
AUTOSHUTDOWN.SOUND_CARD_DOC: Select the sound card interface to monitor for active audio playback (PCM status). Important for external audio sources or Shairport.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.SHUTDOWN_METHOD_DOC: Select 'Standard Shutdown' to turn off the system directly. Select 'Pimoroni OnOff SHIM' if you use the add-on board that requires a GPIO pulse on pin 17 to cut the power supply.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.TOAST_SAVE_MSG: Auto-shutdown settings have been successfully applied.
